title: Friend asks to return borrowed money (romanised Telugu)

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ra Kiran, nenu Suresh ni. Last month nuvvu teesukunna aidu vela gurinchi.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Avunu ra, marchipoya. Ee week lo istha.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sare ra, emi tondara ledu. Salary vachaka GPay cheyyi chalu.
